paths.name: react-querybuilder
paths.message: formatQuery emits raw SQL. Queries are structured QueryAst, never raw SQL from a user or model (CONTEXT.md, docs/decisions/05). Map react-querybuilder's JSON RuleGroupType onto QueryAst instead.

paths.name: @/shared/context/testing
paths.message: Test-only RequestContext constructor — it casts caller-supplied fields (including organizationId) into a branded RequestContext with no session lookup and no membership check. Production code must never import this; see src/shared/context/testing.ts's own doc comment.

paths.name: @/shared/context/request-context
paths.message: createRequestContextForJob takes an explicit organizationId — src/modules/imports/internal/job-context.ts's createContextForImportJob is its one intended caller, which re-derives that value from an already-authorized imports row rather than accepting it from an arbitrary caller. See request-context.ts's own doc comment before importing this elsewhere.
